主要内容: On March 20, 2014, SAP AG, a German-based multinational corporation, announced its decision to propose a dividend of €1.00 per share for the fiscal year 2013 at its Annual General Meeting of Shareholders. This announcement was made through a press release, which is included as Exhibit 99.1 in the Form 6-K filing. The filing is submitted to the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) under Rule 13a-16 or 15d-16 of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934. The document also includes forward-looking statements, which are subject to various risks and uncertainties. These statements are based on SAP's current expectations and are not guaranteed. The company has not provided any specific financial projections or yield estimates in this filing.
